applyTo: "**"

**Desk UI:** use Frappe Desk's standard form/list/tree/report views and widgets (`frappe.ui.form`, dialogs, `frm.add_custom_button`, indicators like `set_indicator(__("Not Saved"), "orange")`). Custom HTML fragments use small Jinja/HTML templates in `healthcare/public/js/*.html` (e.g. `observation.html`, `healthcare_orders.html`) styled with Frappe/Bootstrap classes. Don't add a separate CSS framework to the Desk.

**Patient Portal:** use **frappe-ui** as the component library (`Button`, `Dialog`, `createResource`, `toast`, ...) and **Tailwind CSS** with the **`frappe-ui/tailwind` preset** as the design-token source. `tailwind.config.js` only adds legacy colour aliases (`lightBlue`→sky, `warmGray`→stone, `trueGray`→neutral, `coolGray`→gray, `blueGray`→slate). Icons come from feather-icons/lucide (`lucideIcons: true`). Shared styles go in `patient_portal/src/index.css`, and formatting helpers in `src/utils/formatters.js`.

Reuse frappe-ui components and preset tokens. Don't add raw hex colours or new UI kits.
